title: 金融服务可及性
summary: 评估金融机构服务低收入群体、小微企业与普惠金融的机遇与覆盖面。

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Access to Finance Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how our outputs are determined. Access to Finance is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their positioning to meet market demand for financial services in historically underserved markets.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍金融服务可及性关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解评估结果的形成方式。金融服务可及性属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型社会支柱下的关键议题。公司评估考察其满足历史上服务不足市场金融服务需求的布局与能力。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to Section 2, Data, ratings and scores, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 2 节“数据、评级与得分”。

sections.title_en: Access to Finance Key Issue Score
sections.title_cn: 金融服务可及性关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Access to Finance Key Issue Score evaluates the company's level of exposure to and management of opportunities on this Key Issue. The Key Issue Score is based on the Exposure Score and the Management Score using the formula below. The Exposure Score and the Management Score are combined such that the Exposure Score determines the weight placed on the Management Score, ranging from $50\%$ (when Exposure Score is equal to zero) to $100\%$ (when Exposure Score is equal to 10).
blocks.content_cn: 金融服务可及性关键议题得分评估公司在此议题上的机遇敞口及机遇管理水平。该得分根据敞口得分与管理得分，按下列公式计算。二者的结合方式为：敞口得分决定管理得分的权重，范围从 $50\%$（敞口得分为零）至 $100\%$（敞口得分为 10）。

blocks.content:
$$
\text { Key Issue Score } = \left(\left(\frac {E X P _ {i}}{2 0} +. 5\right) \times M G M T _ {i}\right) + \left(\left(. 5 - \frac {E X P _ {i}}{2 0}\right) \times 5\right)
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $KI_{i}$ is the Key Issue Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $KI_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的关键议题得分。

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{i}$ is the Exposure Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $MGMT_{i}$ is the Management Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $MGMT_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的管理得分。

sections.title_cn: 金融服务可及性管理得分

blocks.content: The Access to Finance Management score is based on the weighted average of the relevant indicator scores, modified by controversies. Default indicator weights may be adjusted for the relevance of business activities; an indicator has zero weight when the company has no exposure to the activity it covers.
blocks.content_cn: 管理得分按适用指标得分加权平均，再按争议事件调整。指标采用默认权重，并可根据公司业务活动的相关性调整；公司对某指标覆盖的业务活动没有敞口时，该指标权重为零。

blocks.content: $$MGMT_i = \sum_j Indicator\_Score_{j,i} \times Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$$

MGMT_i denotes the Management score excluding controversies; j denotes an applicable indicator and i denotes the company. Component scores aggregate indicator scores using weights scaled within the component.
blocks.content_cn: MGMT_i为争议调整前的管理得分；j表示适用指标，i表示公司。组件得分按组件内重新归一化后的指标权重汇总，不应默认将各组件等权平均。

sections.title_cn: • 参与小额信贷或小额保险的程度。

blocks.content: Definition: The type of involvement in microfinance or microinsurance. Best practice is for the company to directly provide microfinance or microinsurance products to customers. Involvement may also come in the form of institutional partnerships, investment vehicles, or charitable giving.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：参与小额信贷或小额保险的方式。最佳实践是直接向客户提供相关产品；也可通过机构合作、投资载体或慈善捐赠参与。

sections.title_en: - Innovation in mobile/online distribution channels for financial services.
sections.title_cn: • 金融服务移动或线上分销渠道创新。

blocks.content: Definition: The company's innovation in mobile/online distribution channels. Best practice is sector-leading innovation in mobile/online distribution targeting underserved demographics. Applies to financial institutions only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在移动或线上分销渠道的创新。最佳实践是面向服务不足人群开展行业领先的渠道创新。仅适用于金融机构。

sections.title_en: - Innovation in other alternative branchless distribution channels for financial services.
sections.title_cn: • 金融服务其他替代性无网点分销渠道创新。

blocks.content: Definition: The company's innovation in alternative branchless distribution channels (e.g., correspondents, partnerships with retail stores/post offices). Applies to financial institutions only.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司在替代性无网点分销渠道的创新，例如代理服务点、与零售店或邮局合作。仅适用于金融机构。

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management Score, based on the severity and type of controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment:
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在此关键议题上所涉争议的严重程度及类型，从总体管理得分中扣减 0—5 分。评估采用以下争议类别：

blocks.content: \- Restricted or discriminatory access to products and services.
blocks.content_cn: • 产品与服务获取受到限制或歧视。

blocks.content: For more details on how controversies are included in the MSCI ESG Ratings model, refer to Section 3.3.2, Controversies cases, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 关于争议如何纳入 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 3.3.2 节“争议案例”。

sections.title_cn: 金融服务可及性风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Access to Finance Exposure Score evaluates the company's exposure to opportunities on this Key Issue. It is based on the Business and Geographic Exposure Scores. The Geographic Exposure Score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure Score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business and Geographic Exposure Scores are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest opportunity and 0 corresponding to the lowest opportunity. Refer to Section 3.2, Analyzing risk exposure, of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure Score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 金融服务可及性敞口得分评估公司在此关键议题上的机遇敞口，以业务和地域敞口得分为基础。地域敞口得分作为业务敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为 -50% 至 +50%。两项得分均采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高机遇水平，0 分对应最低机遇水平。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 3.2 节“风险敞口分析”。敞口得分按以下公式计算：

blocks.content:
$$
E X P _ {A F I, i} = B U S _ {A F I, i} (1 + 0. 1 \bigl (G E O _ {A F I, i} - 5 \bigr))
$$
Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{AFI,i}$ is the Access to Finance Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{AFI,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的金融服务可及性敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $BUS_{AFI,i}$ is the Business Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BUS_{AFI,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的业务敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $GEO_{AFI,i}$ is the Geographic Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $GEO_{AFI,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的地域敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $BSE_{AFI,j}$ is the Business Segment Exposure Score for business segment $j$ .

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure Score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI ESG Research uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure Score. Each business activity score is determined by a qualitative assessment of whether a business activity provides opportunities to increase access to finance through services such as property and casualty insurance, life and health insurance, reinsurance, asset management or other financial services. Business activities with core involvement in these services will have a higher opportunity in providing access to finance.
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI ESG 研究使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部敞口得分。各活动得分通过定性评估确定：是否可通过财产与意外伤害保险、人寿与健康保险、再保险、资产管理或其他金融服务提高金融服务可及性。以这些服务为核心的业务活动，在提供金融服务可及性方面的机遇较高。

blocks.content: The following sources are used to determine the Access to Finance Exposure Score: 'International Monetary Fund (IMF), World Bank, Consultative Group to Assist the Poor (CGAP), SwissRe, World Development Indicators, Refinitiv, MSCI ESG Research, company disclosures.
blocks.content_cn: 以下来源用于确定金融服务可及性敞口得分：国际货币基金组织、世界银行、普惠金融全球合作伙伴组织（CGAP）、瑞士再保险、《世界发展指标》、路孚特、MSCI ESG 研究及公司披露。
